description: GROUP BY over select-list aliases (plain, nested in expressions/functions, ordinals, GROUP BY ALL chains), aliases of FLATTEN values, window ORDER/PARTITION BY raw aggregates, numeric group-key canonicalization across variant casts and scales. Converted 1:1 from query/GroupByAliasKeyTest, GroupByAliasAndWindowKeyTest and GroupKeyNumericCanonicalizationTest (all now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t (c VARCHAR, aid VARCHAR, v NUMBER(10,2), ids ARRAY)
INSERT INTO t SELECT 'x', 'a1', 1, ['t1','t2'] UNION ALL SELECT 'X', 'a2', 2, ['t1'] UNION ALL SELECT 'y', 'a3', 3, ['t2']
SELECT UPPER(c) AS uc, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY uc ORDER BY uc
CREATE TABLE t (c VARCHAR, aid VARCHAR, v NUMBER(10,2), ids ARRAY)
INSERT INTO t SELECT 'x', 'a1', 1, ['t1','t2'] UNION ALL SELECT 'X', 'a2', 2, ['t1'] UNION ALL SELECT 'y', 'a3', 3, ['t2']
SELECT UPPER(c) AS c, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY c ORDER BY 1, 2
CREATE TABLE t (c VARCHAR, aid VARCHAR, v NUMBER(10,2), ids ARRAY)
INSERT INTO t SELECT 'x', 'a1', 1, ['t1','t2'] UNION ALL SELECT 'X', 'a2', 2, ['t1'] UNION ALL SELECT 'y', 'a3', 3, ['t2']
SELECT c, value::string AS tid, AVG(v), COUNT(DISTINCT aid) FROM t, TABLE(FLATTEN(ids)) GROUP BY c, tid ORDER BY c, tid
SELECT UPPER(c) AS uc, value::string AS tid, AVG(v) FROM t, TABLE(FLATTEN(ids)) GROUP BY uc, tid ORDER BY uc, tid
CREATE TABLE t (c VARCHAR, aid VARCHAR, v NUMBER(10,2), ids ARRAY)
INSERT INTO t SELECT 'x', 'a1', 1, ['t1','t2'] UNION ALL SELECT 'X', 'a2', 2, ['t1'] UNION ALL SELECT 'y', 'a3', 3, ['t2']
SELECT UPPER(c) AS uc, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT UPPER(c) AS uc, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY UPPER(c) ORDER BY 1
CREATE TABLE acct (tag VARCHAR, members NUMBER, pairs VARIANT)
INSERT INTO acct SELECT 'human', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1,2]') UNION ALL SELECT 'human', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1,2]') UNION ALL SELECT 'human', 3, PARSE_JSON('[1]') UNION ALL SELECT 'svc', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1]')

SELECT tag, members AS n_members, CASE WHEN tag = 'human' AND n_members = 1 THEN 'own' ELSE 'other' END AS klass, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM acct GROUP BY tag, n_members, CASE WHEN tag = 'human' AND n_members = 1 THEN 'own' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY tag, n_members
CREATE TABLE acct (tag VARCHAR, members NUMBER, pairs VARIANT)
INSERT INTO acct SELECT 'human', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1,2]') UNION ALL SELECT 'human', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1,2]') UNION ALL SELECT 'human', 3, PARSE_JSON('[1]') UNION ALL SELECT 'svc', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1]')
SELECT pairs AS pre_pairs, ARRAY_SIZE(pre_pairs) AS sz, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM acct GROUP BY pre_pairs, ARRAY_SIZE(pre_pairs) ORDER BY sz
CREATE TABLE acct (tag VARCHAR, members NUMBER, pairs VARIANT)
INSERT INTO acct SELECT 'human', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1,2]') UNION ALL SELECT 'human', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1,2]') UNION ALL SELECT 'human', 3, PARSE_JSON('[1]') UNION ALL SELECT 'svc', 1, PARSE_JSON('[1]')
SELECT tag, SUM(members) AS tot, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(members) DESC) AS rn FROM acct GROUP BY tag ORDER BY rn
CREATE TABLE t2 (grp VARCHAR, v NUMBER)
INSERT INTO t2 SELECT 'a', 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'b', 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'c', 20
SELECT grp, SUM(v) AS tot, COUNT(grp) OVER (PARTITION BY SUM(v)) AS same_tot_groups FROM t2 GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp
CREATE TABLE logins (dev VARCHAR, tag VARCHAR, login VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO logins SELECT 'dev1','human','u1' UNION ALL SELECT 'dev2','human','u2' UNION ALL SELECT 'dev2','human','u3' UNION ALL SELECT 'dev3','svc','u4'
SELECT dev, tag, count(*) as n_members, CASE WHEN tag = 'human' AND n_members = 1 THEN 'owner' ELSE tag END as owner_tag FROM logins GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY dev
CREATE TABLE srcfiles (fname VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO srcfiles SELECT 'a-1.json' UNION ALL SELECT 'a-1.json' UNION ALL SELECT 'b-2.json'
SELECT SPLIT(fname, '-') as fname_split, fname_split[1]::VARCHAR as suffix, count(*) as cnt FROM srcfiles GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY suffix
CREATE TABLE metric (grp VARCHAR, sub VARCHAR, item VARCHAR, m NUMBER, sev NUMBER)
INSERT INTO metric SELECT 'g1','a:1','d1',10,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'g1','a:1','d2',5,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g1','b:2','d3',30,1 UNION ALL SELECT 'g1','c:3','d4',20,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g2','a:1','d5',7,1

SELECT grp, sub AS proposed, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT item) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY item ASC) AS targeted, SUM(m) AS ranking_metric, SUM(sev) AS pasl_sum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY ranking_metric DESC, pasl_sum DESC, try_cast(split_part(proposed, ':', 2) as number) desc) AS rnk FROM metric GROUP BY grp, sub ORDER BY grp, rnk
SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT PARSE_JSON('{"n":1}'):n::NUMBER AS k UNION ALL SELECT 1) GROUP BY k
SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT 1 AS k UNION ALL SELECT 1.0 UNION ALL SELECT 1.00 UNION ALL SELECT 2) GROUP BY k ORDER BY k
SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT 1.5 AS k UNION ALL SELECT 1.50 UNION ALL SELECT 1.25) GROUP BY k ORDER BY k
SELECT k, src FROM (SELECT PARSE_JSON('{"n":1}'):n::NUMBER AS k, 'a' AS src UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'b') QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY src) = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS c FROM (SELECT PARSE_JSON('{"n":7}'):n::NUMBER AS k UNION ALL SELECT 7)
